Standard or Deep Clean?

Same care. Different level of detail.

The difference is not just “more time.” It is the level of detail, buildup removal and number of surfaces included.

Standard Cleaning

For consistency.

Best for homes that already receive regular cleaning and need dependable maintenance.

  • Essential surfaces
  • Kitchen & bathroom maintenance
  • Floors, mirrors and visible dust
  • Light tidying
  • Best for recurring service
Deep Cleaning

For a full reset.

Best for first visits, visible buildup, seasonal resets or homes that have gone longer between professional cleanings.

  • Everything in Standard
  • Baseboards, edges and detailed corners
  • More buildup removal
  • More detailed kitchen & bathroom attention
  • Best starting point for homes needing extra care
Not sure which one you need? Send us photos or tell us about the home. We’ll recommend the right level of service — not more than your home needs.

Recurring care

The longer the interval, the more there is to reset.

That is why weekly, biweekly and monthly visits are priced differently even when the home is the same size.

Weekly

For homes that stay busy.

Less buildup between visits. Ideal for families, pets and clients who want the home consistently maintained.

Starting at $109 / visit
Most balanced

Biweekly

A strong balance between consistency and value. More buildup than weekly, but still easy to maintain professionally.

Starting at $119 / visit
Monthly

A professional reset every month.

Longer intervals mean more dust, kitchen buildup, bathroom work and floor recovery at each visit.

Starting at $139 / visit
How pricing works

We price the project — not the clock.

Your estimate is based on the home, the service level and the actual scope. You receive the project price before service.

Pricing may consider square footage, bedrooms and bathrooms, current condition, frequency, pets, buildup, selected extras, accessibility and special requests.
